title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and set the translation vector to zero, zero, and zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle with a center at zero point zero two one, zero point zero two one and a radius of zero point zero two one. Draw the second loop as another circle with the same center but a radius of zero point zero one four. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of zero point zero four two. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by zero point seven five units to create a new solid body. The resulting shape is a cylindrical object with a smooth surface and rounded edges, measuring zero point zero four two units in both length and width, and zero point seven five units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circles
center = (0.021, 0.021)
radius_outer = 0.021
radius_inner = 0.014

# Create the outer circle
r = r.center(center[0], center[1]).circle(radius_outer)

# Create the inner circle (for the hole)
r = r.circle(radius_inner)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Create a hollow cylindrical tube along the X axis
# Outer diameter 0.042, inner diameter 0.025, length 0.75
outer_radius = 0.021
inner_radius = 0.0125
length = 0.75

# Build the tube profile on the YZ plane and extrude along X
r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .circle(outer_radius)
    .circle(inner_radius)
    .extrude(length)
)
